notablePrerequisites:
Belt of Giant Strength and Burning Anger attached to Vessel of the All-Consuming.
Vessel of the All Consuming does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Vessel of the All-Consuming by tapping it, dealing at least ten damage to any opponent.
Vessel of the All-Consuming's first and second ability trigger.
Resolve Vessel of the All-Consuming's first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Vessel of the All-Consuming's second trigger, causing that opponent to lose the game.

uses.name: Hidetsugu Consumes All // Vessel of the All-Consuming
